review.method: Assistant visual review of all ten fixed checkpoint tiles, blind to M3G detector/candidate outputs. Visible 2D extents corrected from projected 3D boxes. Not independent human semantic adjudication.
review.limits: Selected targets only; not exhaustive scene annotation. Low-speed clip includes acceleration, crossing and overtaking. Dark/occluded riders and ambiguous projected targets explicitly omitted before inference; those omissions do not establish absence or safety.
